usedFor: Kajabi sells your offers, and Calendly receives a meeting when “New Purchased” runs “Create One-Time Meeting”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Purchased” in Kajabi, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A purchase is the moment to book time with the buyer, so a one-time meeting is ready straight away.

watchOut: Repeat purchases each run “Create One-Time Meeting”, so one customer can end up with several meetings.
